articles.headline: SK Hynix says Indiana AI chip output starts in 2029 as memory shortage may last through 2030
articles.summary: SK Hynix said it plans to begin volume production of next-generation HBM4E chips at its Indiana facility in the third quarter of 2029. The company also warned that the current memory chip shortage could persist through the end of 2030, which matters for AI infrastructure budgets, supply planning, and hardware procurement.

articles.headline: Marvell’s AI chip deal with Google fails to lift long-term outlook enough for investors
articles.summary: Marvell reportedly signed a major new AI chip agreement with Google, but it did not provide a meaningful increase to its long-term revenue outlook. For businesses tracking AI infrastructure costs and supplier momentum, the story suggests that large chip deals are not yet translating into the demand visibility investors want.

articles.headline: Russian-speaking cybercriminals used Cursor AI tool to hack seven companies
articles.summary: Reuters reported that cybercriminals abused an AI coding tool to break into seven companies, underscoring how developer productivity tools can also expand attack surfaces. That raises immediate risk concerns for enterprises relying on AI-assisted software development, identity controls, and vendor security reviews.
